title: Waystone
body:
Waystone (Java 1.21.11) is a small, whitelisted, hermitcraft-style SMP that's been running the same world since 2 December 2025 - no resets, no seasons, no economy.

It's built for people who actually want to settle somewhere. We've got a fair few towns already taking shape, and the kind of community where people genuinely know each other. If you're the type to spend a Saturday on a build and log off happy, you'll fit in fine.

A few things that make it a bit different:

1. No teleport commands - you get around via waystones scattered across the world, so travel actually means something. It makes the map feel alive and gives you a reason to explore.

2. Skills that grow as you play - ValhallaMMO levels up naturally through mining, building, trading and combat. No grinding required, it just happens in the background while you do your thing.

3. Playtime ranks - the longer you're part of the community, the more you unlock. It's a nice way of recognising the people who stick around.

4. Custom plugins built for Waystone - not just a stack of off-the-shelf mods. Things like /binbag to clear junk, /salvage to reclaim materials, and a fully custom rank progression system built specifically for this server. Not to mention plenty more on the way!

5. SimpleVoiceChat - yes, we use it! Chat locally with people around you with proximity chat or in groups.

6. Weekly events and transparent development - we run regular community events and are open about what we're working on. If something's changing, you'll know about it before it happens.

7. Staff who actually play - we're not just admins keeping the lights on. We're on the server, in the towns, part of the same community you'd be joining.

8. Deaths drop a gravestone - that holds your items for hours, so one bad moment doesn't cost you an evening's progress.

PvP is consent-based, so you'll never get jumped unless you're into that. Land claims keep your builds safe, and the whole world is viewable on our live map at map.waystone.world.

We're a mature community, but everyone is welcome to apply - we care more about the kind of player you are than how old you are.
